description: This file defines the RequestWrapper class, a custom HttpServletRequestWrapper that reads and caches request input stream data for multiple reads, primarily used in servlet-based web applications.

classes.name: RequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletRequest that allows multiple reads of the request body by caching the input stream data.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader over the cached request bytes.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream that reads from the cached request bytes.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Reads and caches the request input stream bytes on first call.
